dialogues.speaker: Dozorov
dialogues.text: That would be Master Childe himself! Ah, I basically watched the boy grow up. Even back then, he was always an absolute handful... I mean, a remarkably sharp-witted child!

dialogues.speaker: Dozorov
dialogues.text: He wasn't even ten when he started heading out to sea with the older teenagers. He'd even sneakily... "borrow" the dried fish hanging in my yard!

dialogues.speaker: Dozorov
dialogues.text: I could tell even then that the kid was bound to become a total monster... I mean, a mastermind! A man of great consequence!
